scaled_motion_vs_published_motion.note: a ratio of 1 means the frozen gauge moves the reconstruction the right number of metres; ground truth is read for this diagnostic only

moge_consistency_probe.note: a consistency check between two monocular estimates, NOT a ground-truth scale; these MoGe calls are outside the inference loop and outside every timing figure

clip_reset_motion_ratio.note: the reference re-estimates its gauge at every anchor, so a flat curve here against a drifting mode-B curve localises the drift to the persistent state and the frozen gauge

state_trace.note: resets at counter 0 precede any frame; a reset at the peak follows the last frame. Only a reset strictly between the two would break the persistent-state requirement.
